subject: Recap + next steps: ClearWell buying process and exception requests
messages:
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Tom Halpern <tom.halpern@clearwelldx.com>
Cc: 
Date: Thu, 12 Feb 2026 15:03:00 -0800
Subject: Recap from today — stakeholder map & next steps

Tom — thanks again for the call today. Quick recap and the next steps I promised: 

Summary of who we heard on the call
- Mike Romano — VP Engineering (economic buyer)
- Karen Liu — Procurement (procurement@clearwelldx.com)
- Anya Petrov — InfoSec lead (anya.petrov@clearwelldx.com)

Decision criteria you highlighted
- End-to-end latency under 200ms for inference at 512 tokens
- Audit logs & retention for 1 year
- SOC 2 Type II evidence and pen test report
- Predictable pricing for pilot (monthly cap)

Your stated procurement steps
1) Procurement sends checklist (you said procurement@clearwelldx.com)
2) InfoSec review and gap assessment (Anya)
3) Finance & Legal signoff and DocuSign

Open asks for us
- Confirm what you need from us for InfoSec (SOC2, architecture diagram, pen test windows)
- Your preferred pilot term (you mentioned 3 months) and target go-live
- Any buying-process exceptions you expect (discounts, SLA changes, data flow exceptions)

Attachments: redwood-sales-deck.pdf (overview for the execs)

Next steps I propose
- I will send a short MPA template and map the approvals required by name
- You to share procurement checklist and target DocuSign contact

If that matches your notes, I’ll loop in our security & legal to get the artifacts queued.

Thanks — Rishi
Rishi Malhotra
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
[Attachment: redwood-sales-deck.pdf (pdf)]
From: Tom Halpern <tom.halpern@clearwelldx.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@clearwelldx.com; Anya Petrov <anya.petrov@clearwelldx.com>
Date: Thu, 12 Feb 2026 16:28:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Recap from today — stakeholder map & next steps

Thanks Rishi — that recap is accurate. A few specifics from procurement/InfoSec side: 

Procurement checklist (what we’ll evaluate)
- Standard SOW + pricing cap clause
- Data processing addendum (DPA) and data flow diagram
- Insurance certificates

InfoSec asks (Anya's list)
- SOC 2 Type II report (last 12 months)
- Recent pen-test summary (past 12 months)
- Architecture diagram showing KV cache & telemetry retention

Exceptions we may request (why I’m copying procurement & Anya)
- Pilot discount: we’re asking for a 30% concession for a 3-month pilot (budget constrained)
- SLA tweak: pilot SLA to be 99.9% (we understand production terms may differ)
- Minor tokenization exception: we’d like to leave PII tokenized on our side and allow some encrypted logs for debug — InfoSec to confirm.

Timeline: we want procurement review complete by 2/26 if possible. I attached the procurement checklist we use.

Tom
Tom Halpern
Director of Platform Engineering, ClearWell Diagnostics
[Attachment: CWD_procurement_checklist.xlsx (xlsx)]
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.ai>, Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
Cc: 
Date: Fri, 13 Feb 2026 09:02:00 -0800
Subject: Fwd: ClearWell procurement checklist + exception asks — approvers and asks for internal review

Team — forwarding ClearWell’s ask from earlier today. TL;DR: pilot, asks for 30% discount, pilot SLA 99.9, and a small InfoSec/data flow exception request. They want procurement review done by 2/26.

Why this matters: ClearWell is a mid-market lab network — low latency and auditability are must-haves. Economic buyer is Mike Romano (VP Eng) — if we move quick we can lock a reserved pilot.

My asks (please reply inline):
1) Pricing: approve up to what discount for a 3-month pilot (they asked 30%)? (Marissa + Aditya)
2) Security: can we support a limited tokenization/data-flow exception for a pilot if they use our Private VPC option + additional logging controls? (Sergio + Ava)
3) SLA: can we accept a 99.9% pilot SLA for 3 months or do we require fallback language? (Marissa + Ava)

Attachments I’m adding that summarize our asks: clearwell-summary-for-ops.docx, redwood-exception-request.docx

Proposed timeline from our side:
- 2/13: internal approvals
- 2/16: initial InfoSec call with Anya
- 2/18: send pilot MPA + DocuSign

Thanks — please tag approvals or alternate suggestions.

Rishi
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
[Attachment: clearwell-summary-for-ops.docx (docx)]
[Attachment: redwood-exception-request.docx (docx)]
From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.ai>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
Cc: 
Date: Fri, 13 Feb 2026 11:07:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Fwd: ClearWell procurement checklist + exception asks — approvers and asks for internal review

Rishi / team — thanks for the context. Preliminary InfoSec read: 

Must-have artifacts before any exception:
- SOC 2 Type II report (latest)
- Pen-test summary and remediation plan
- Network diagram showing VPC peering and where keys live

On the tokenization/data-flow exception:
- I can support a scoped exception for a pilot if: (a) ClearWell runs in Private VPC, (b) we get a signed DPA limiting debug logs, and (c) we restrict asked-attribution fields.
- We should require an explicit retention period (no more than 90 days for logs containing any masked PII).

SLA: we can accept a provisional 99.9% pilot SLA if (1) the MPA includes a rollback/fallback clause to hosted-host fallback, and (2) we add an operational playbook for escalations.

Next steps from InfoSec: schedule 1-hour technical call with Anya to validate VPC connectivity and key management. I attached the security-eval-template I’ll use for that call.

Sergio Alvarez
Head of Security & Compliance | Redwood Inference
[Attachment: security-eval-template.pdf (pdf)]
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>, Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.ai>, Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwood.ai>
Cc: 
Date: Fri, 13 Feb 2026 14:22:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Fwd: ClearWell procurement checklist + exception asks — approvals

Rishi — thanks for the summary. I’m comfortable with a one-time pilot concession but with limits: 

Pricing approval
- Approve up to 25% one-time discount for a 3-month pilot (not the full 30% requested).
- Any additional credits must be escalated to revenue ops and justified with projected ARR.

SLA/Legal
- Accept provisional 99.9% pilot SLA limited to the pilot term. Legal (Ava) to redline fallback language and ensure no long-term SLA precedence.

Security
- Support Sergio’s scoped exception approach (Private VPC + DPA + retention limits).

Action items
- Rishi: get SOC2 + pen-test summary into the shared HubSpot record and schedule InfoSec call for 2/16.
- Ava: prepare MPA template with SLA fallback and pilot clauses.
- Aditya: final sign-off on the 25% pilot concession (please confirm).

If Aditya confirms financially, we’ll push MPA to procurement and target DocuSign by 2/18.

-Marissa
VP Sales | Redwood Inference
From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>, Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.ai>, Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwood.ai>
Cc: 
Date: Sat, 14 Feb 2026 10:12:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Fwd: ClearWell procurement checklist + exception asks — approvals

I approve the 25% one-time pilot discount and the limited pilot SLA concession under the conditions Marissa and Sergio outlined. A few notes: 

- Finance note: pilot discount capped to projected pilot spend; no retroactive credits.
- Legal: please add a redlined clause that the pilot SLA does not set precedence for enterprise contracts.
- Rishi: build the MPA with the exact list of deliverables and include the DocuSign template link below.

DocuSign template for pilot MPA (use and populate): https://www.docusign.com/templates/CWD-pilot-2026

Aditya
VP Revenue Operations | Redwood Inference
